prose: The Financial Times, citing SemiAnalysis, reports that China has 24 gigawatts of operational compute capacity and another 50 GW planned or under construction, compared with 56 GW operational in the US. It describes AI infrastructure rolling out quickly in Inner Mongolia.
The article is paywalled, so this is based on the Techmeme excerpt only.
highlights: China: 24 GW operational, 50 GW planned or being built
Source is SemiAnalysis via the FT
